critical_code_review_comments: YorbaLinda.jsx inlines a second <script type=application/ld+json> outside Helmet - works because React renders it into the DOM, but it will not be portalled to <head>. Google still reads JSON-LD from <body>, so acceptable, but consider using Helmet's script prop for consistency with other pages.

Note: the FAQ answer for question #1 uses non-breaking phrasing and the address block relies on em-dash characters. Consider adding a schema.org LocalBusiness sameAs field with Google Business Profile URL for stronger local SEO signal.
